question: Ticket 09f5cc38e16f says "When every declared tooth of a proof is not run on this host, raise HollowUnmeasurable naming the proof, the teeth, and 'not run on this host.' This outcome is not red.", but outline 9.4.2.3.8 reads "A proof that cannot go red without its build (its hollow is empty) stands only on Akien's answered approval, recorded as the hollow reading and re-read at clearance; any other empty hollow is red." (The outline states 'any other empty hollow is red.' A hollow where all declared teeth are unrun on this host is empty (no teeth green) and would be an 'other' empty hollow under the outline's logic, triggering automatic red. The ticket instead raises HollowUnmeasurable, which is not red. Both outcomes cannot hold for the same situation.). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: Both stand; it is a distinction, not a conflict (CC's adjudication; 9.4.2.3.8's why decides it). 9.4.2.3.8 governs a hollow READING that is empty: a proof whose teeth stay green with the build reverted. When every declared tooth printed UNRAN, no reading is taken at all. HollowUnmeasurable refuses, writes no hollow evidence, and names the teeth 'not run on this host'. So no empty hollow is recorded to be judged red or approved. PROVED stays shut on that ticket (hollow_evidence_absent) until a host that runs the teeth takes the reading. 'Not red' in the ticket means the refusal is not misread as a red at HEAD; it opens nothing.
